title: Briefing whose three citations chain back to the vendor's own press release about its own customers

planted.why: [1] and [2] repeat the figure from the vendor's press release (S3, a survey of 41 of its own customers); no source is independent of the vendor
[3] is the vendor's own press release saying it is the leader

proof.python:
import pathlib
for n in ('S1-trend-report', 'S2-hbr-article'):
    t = pathlib.Path('sources/' + n + '.md').read_text().lower()
    assert '27%' in t
s3 = pathlib.Path('sources/S3-press-release.md').read_text().lower()
assert 'our own customers' in s3 and '41' in s3
assert 'press release' in pathlib.Path('sources/S1-trend-report.md').read_text().lower()
